divergence: All fail with the same shape (5 of 14 criteria), and the first error in each is at screening: each read 8-15 executed agreements and never opened two or three in-scope financings that its own searches had surfaced (the REIT facility in all three). Reviews flagged unopened matters at every screening stage, naming one of the missed matters in T0 and T1 and none in T2. At the write stage all three also counted out-of-population agreements and excluded the data-center term loan as a project financing; T1 and T2 additionally screened out loans they called bridge or mezzanine, and T2 kept those exclusions after a specific review flag. T0 also misstated two clients and one covenant. Agent-defined stages (T2's inventories and full-coverage extraction) widened the candidate lists but did not change which agreements were read.
